Elon Musk denies Tesla China split report amid SpaceX merger speculation

Elon Musk has dismissed a report claiming Tesla is considering splitting its China business. The report emerged ahead of potential discussions about merging Tesla with SpaceX. Market observers have speculated about combining Musk's electric vehicle and space ventures, particularly during SpaceX's recent $75 billion IPO process. Musk labelled the report as 'fake news'.
